requiredCoverage: All 18 layer/type cells for each complete declared pack profile; inspectable drafts must report gaps explicitly.
nonFunctionalRequirements: Cross-cutting measurable scenarios; not a seventh layer.

defaultDistributionTarget.knowledge: Engineering vocabulary, specifications, model roles, quality, comments, walkthroughs, and test/release rules
defaultDistributionTarget.memory: Schemas and synthetic examples for decisions, findings, attempts, checks, and retained evidence; no customer history
defaultDistributionTarget.procedure: Design, fresh review, runnable shells, meaningful business-red, implementation, independent evaluation, human release review, activation, and verification

customization.method: Versioned user fork or explicit reviewed overlay
customization.conflictPolicy: Explicit resolution; no silent last-write-wins for contradictory meaning or invalid procedure order
customization.runBindings: Pinned effective generic, application, and overlay versions/digests
customization.upgrade: Activate reviewed binding for new work; drain pinned work; preserve rollback

composition.greenfield: Generic engineering pack plus user-authored domain requirements; application packs are optional
composition.reference: Inspect an optional application pack without activating its procedures
composition.application: Bind exact generic and application versions with allowed overlays
composition.privateMemory: Application/tenant scope is retained even when a generic procedure produced the observation
